answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 66461 Country: India Title: Is gusl obligatory in this case? Question: My question is if a wife is stimulating (giving oral sex to him) her husband, without her own private parts being touched. Meanwhile, she gets intense sexual pleasure too without her body parts being touched by her husband a tingling sensation but she doesn’t see any wet thing released from her body on her clothes.
